title: Urgent recall for popular bottled water sold at supermarkets across Australia - Yahoo Lifestyle Australia
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Product recall for Pump water from Woolworths, Coles, Aldi, IGA and other retailers
 The five versions of the popular water bottle have a packaging defect. 
 Stewart Perrie Tue 3 November 2026 at 5:06 am UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. A major product recall alert has been issued across Australia for an item you can buy just about anywhere.
 Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Australia is pulling five versions of its popular Pump water bottles due to a packaging defect .
 Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) said there is a risk of the white sipper dislodging, which could be a potential choking hazard.
 Five versions of Pump water bottles have been recalled from supermarkets and retailers across the country.
 (Getty) Do you have a story? Email stew.perrie@yahooinc.com 
 "Consumers should not drink this product," the safety body said.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Consumers should return the product(s) to the place of purchase for a full refund.
 "Any consumers concerned about their health should seek medical advice."
 The recall affects the following versions of Pump:
 Super Pump Spring Water - 1.25L
 Pump Spring Water - 750mL
 Pump Watermelon Hit - 750mL
 Pump Berry Storm
 750mL Pump Lime Rush - 750mL
 These Pump water bottles have been recalled across Australia.
 (FSANZ/Getty) The affected batches have Best Before markings up to and including BB 22 January 2028.
 The product was sold in Woolworths, Coles, Aldi, independent food retailers including IGA, petrol stations, convenience stores, newsagents, vending machines and retail outlets nationally and online.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement If you have questions or need more information about the recall, you can contact Coca-Cola.
 The company has a hotline at +61 2 8249 9113 and an email address at consumer_information@ccep.com . 
 Alternatively, you can visit their website here .
